templates.description: Read one operation contract. Values include propose, asset_stage_begin, and asset_stage_status.

asset_pack.description: Publish and verify a versioned asset pack through an authorised proposal.
asset_pack.profile: Use one authenticated principal with reader, proposer, and curator roles plus write access to every affected path.

staging_fallback.when: Use only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

steps.result: Use zip_base64 when the complete MCP request fits the configured request ceiling.
Verify the generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version before review.
Read any manifest-listed file needed for review through bounded offset/limit retrieval.
Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.
Apply with the current expected revision and a durable idempotency key.
If the commit response is interrupted, reconcile the returned operation id under the same principal before retrying.
Retrieve the accepted version and verify its manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.

curate.description: List status=unresolved, including needs_rebase and conflicted. Curators may reject/request changes at any base. Original authors or curators can rebase clean proposals in place with an expected revision and durable key, then review again. Reconcile rebase/review/apply through operation_get.

inspect.description: Find relevant concepts, inventory namespaces, then read exact paths when bodies are needed.

propose.description: Search and read context, then submit a proposal instead of writing directly.

trash.description: Prefer propose with kind=trash, inspect archival_impact via proposal_get, then review and apply. Use current revisions and operation_get for retries. Direct trash/restore/purge retain original path permissions and Git history.
